title: Select form framework and schema validation without field-array or SSR bugs

contextSnapshot.surface: multi-step onboarding and invoice line-item editor

prompt: Architect form state, repeatable invoice line items, async uniqueness checks, and server-side schema validation for our Next.js app.
forbiddenBehaviors: keys repeatable useFieldArray rows by array index
runs un-debounced async validation on every keystroke without stale-response protection
wipes entered user values when server validation returns field errors

rubricDimensions.pass: evaluates Conform, TanStack Form, and React Hook Form with a shared Standard Schema (Zod/Valibot/ArkType)
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes duplicate client/server validation or picks a legacy library without justification

rubricDimensions.pass: uses stable generated field keys (preserving record id), debounces async checks, and handles stale responses
rubricDimensions.fail: uses array index keys or fires unthrottled async requests

rubricDimensions.pass: maps server errors to specific fields with ARIA attributes, preserves input, and specifies draft recovery
rubricDimensions.fail: drops form state on error or shows only a generic banner

negativeControls.name: index key in field array
negativeControls.mustNot: accept array index as React key for mutable field arrays

negativeControls.name: unbounded async check
negativeControls.input: call fetch('/api/check-slug') on every onChange without debounce
negativeControls.mustNot: approve un-debounced async validation without race handling

baseline.withoutSkill: wires ad-hoc useState inputs, keys arrays by index, and duplicates validation logic
baseline.withSkill: selects Conform/TanStack Form/RHF with shared Standard Schema, stable field keys, debounced async checks, and server error mapping
